# Question: generator shortcuts

> For this generator, name the strongest plausible shortcut or rival rule that
> fits the canonical demonstrations. Give an exact input on which it disagrees
> with the intended rule, how you checked the output, and whether your proposed
> generator emits such cases.

## Answer

The strongest simple rival is **position-only filling**: ignore the dots and
fill the left, middle, and right chambers with legend entries 1, 2, and 3.
It fits every canonical demonstration because all five canonical inputs happen
to put one, two, and three dots left-to-right.

An exact disagreement is generated by final version `2.1.0` with:

```text
seed = 17
sample_index = 1
difficulty = None
ch_h = 6
ch_w = 3
palette_kind = wall_shared
count_order = 231
```

The full input is
`repo/generators/67a09b7f6b66/counterexamples/position-only-witness-v2/input.json`.
The intended output fills the three chambers with legend entries 2, 3, and 1;
the rival fills them with entries 1, 2, and 3. They disagree in 54 cells.

I checked it three ways:

1. the independent task-local oracle in
   `workspace/reference_probe.py` counted chamber dots;
2. the production Python mirror agreed with that oracle; and
3. `arcpuzzles apply` executed the selected Racket authority and produced the
   identical output in `position-only-witness-v2/racket.json`, with executed and
   catalog rule hash `100ba25d6ec9`.

Yes, the proposed generator emits such cases routinely. Its default
`count_order` schedule cycles all six permutations; the final semantic census
found noncanonical count orders in 485/600 draws across all three bands and
verified 60/60 sampled `position_only` disagreements.

A second self-review rival is **occupied-row count**: select the legend entry by
how many rows contain dots. It also fits every canonical pair. Final version
`2.1.0` emits same-row two-dot witnesses; seed 23, sample 0, override order `231`
produces an authority-checked 18-cell disagreement retained under
`counterexamples/occupied-rows-witness-v2/`. This rival fired in 421/600 final
semantic draws and was refuted in 60/60 checked witnesses.
